thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms: a person standing at a doorway looking out into morning light, bag down, unhurried, one hand on the frame. Sarangi at the FRAME EDGE, NOT being played. Warm gold light spilling in across a cool interior floor. Pichwai/Kangra miniature border, aged parchment, house palette. Text banner ~35% of frame, second tier 'Sarangi · Raga Jaunpuri'. VIEWER LIVING THE MOMENT, never a performer — measured 6.11% vs 3.03%.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — unhurried Indian classical sarangi in Raga Jaunpuri, warm bowed string tone with vocal-like glides and long sustain, continuous tanpura drone underneath, no tabla, 60 BPM, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: ANXIETY lane. Sarangi's defining characteristic is the vocal-like glide — name it, per the Suno prompt patterns (physical instrument description is the #1 marker). 'unhurried' not 'slow'. No tabla (Sitar-only rule). 60 BPM, above the retention floor. Binaural: theta 6 Hz at -20dB.

production_spec.loop_note: 6-7 unhurried Jaunpuri sarangi clips over a continuous tanpura bed, long crossfades to ~90 min, consistent warm level. No percussion.
